collocations: take a dainty little bite of the apple：文雅地咬了一小口苹果
words.definition: 娇小的，精致的，漂亮的；文雅的，优雅的
words.etymology: c. 1300, deinte, “delightful, pleasing” (late 12c. as a surname), from dainty (n.); see below. Meaning evolved in Middle English to “choice, excellent” (late 14c.) to “delicately pretty, exhibiting exquisite taste or skill” (c. 1400). Sense of “fastidious, affectedly fine, weak, effeminate” is from 1570s. Related: Daintiness.
examples:
The girls were dainty and feminine.
这些女子们娇美而又温柔。
